title: FlexLine Returned-Payment Fee Amount
content:
**Clause — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** The returned-payment fee is the tier's returned-payment fee for the return, never more than the minimum payment due, rounded to the cent. The most recent returned payment is the latest return on the line by return date (of two returns on the same date, the one recorded first).

- *Tier's returned-payment fee*: the per-tier figure in the product's returned-payment schedule.
- *Minimum payment due*: the minimum payment due on Larkspur's record of the line on the booking date.
- *Rounding*: the fee is held to no more than the minimum payment due and rounded to the cent; every rounding to the cent here takes an exact half cent to the even cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, a tier fee of 15.00 USD)

| Minimum payment due | Fee |
|---|---|
| 85.00 | 15.00 USD |
| 12.60 | 12.60 USD |

*Which return is the most recent:* returns dated 2 May and 19 May — the 19 May return; two returns both dated 19 May — the one recorded first.
